transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?
I’ve barely been eating lately. Some days it’s just coffee and maybe a piece of bread. My pants are getting loose on me.
Are you intentionally trying to lose weight?
No, I’m not trying to lose weight. I just hardly feel like eating—some days it’s only coffee and a piece of bread. My pants are getting really loose.
How has your mood been lately?
Most days I wake up feeling really heavy and empty in my chest. It feels like there’s nothing good waiting for me, so I just want to keep my head down.
About how long have you been feeling this heavy, empty feeling and having trouble eating?
It’s been about five months now. It’s just been hanging over me that whole time.
Did something major or particularly stressful happen in your life around the time these feelings began?
I’m not sure. I can’t think of one big thing that happened around then. It just kind of started and kept getting worse.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy doing?
Yeah. I used to enjoy walking by the lake and working on my little model kits, but now they just sit there. I look at them like they belong to somebody else.
How has your sleep been during this time?

It’s been bad. Some nights I lie there for hours just staring at the wall, and other times I wake up before the sun and can’t get back to sleep. Even when I do sleep, I still wake up feeling worn out.
With everything feeling so heavy, have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I’m not sure what you mean. I know things have been really hard, but… I don’t know.
Have you been having feelings of worthlessness or feeling guilty about things?
Yeah. I keep thinking I’m no good because I lost that job and my relatives have to help me now. I go over every mistake I made, like I ruined everything.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt the opposite—unusually energized, overly happy, or needing much less sleep than usual?
Yeah… there was a time when I was only sleeping maybe two or three hours a night, but I’d wake up and jump right up like I’d slept all night.
About how long did that period of needing very little sleep and having so much energy last?
It’s been about a month—the whole swing from feeling really driven after I got fired to feeling this low.
